## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete problem and what a user experiences after this change.

## Scope

List the affected areas and any compatibility, data, model-context or permission implications.

## Validation

Record actual commands/checks, results and platform. Clearly identify checks not run. For visible changes, include redacted screenshots and tested window sizes/display scales. Linux checks do not establish Windows acceptance.

## Review checklist

- [ ] SAFE MODE, mandatory approvals, protected paths and stale-review/source checks remain intact.
- [ ] No credentials, private workspace content, settings, conversations, runtime logs or vault data are included.
- [ ] Meaningful regression coverage is included for behavior changes, or its omission is explained.
- [ ] UI changes preserve keyboard focus, accessible names, readable text and reachable controls.
- [ ] Documentation reflects the resulting behavior, known limitations and checks not completed.

## Related issue

Link an issue when applicable. Do not link publicly disclosed exploit details for a private vulnerability report.
